text:
maya: follow-up on precision policy RFC. customers ask to pin fp8; ops requires safe fallbacks. how do we keep surface area small?

jordan: condensed pattern: policy = ordered variants + small safety gates (deg_threshold, p99_latency_ms, canary_rate). runtime picks top-ranked variant that passes gates.

sam: add cache_compat boolean. if false -> flush prefix/KV on switch; if true -> hot-swap. default false.

maya: in-flight semantics: let in-flight complete on original precision, new requests use new variant. avoids mixed-response artifacts.

jordan: prefer separate precision_policy object referenced by route (precision_policy_id) for reuse.

sam: telemetry: quality_signal_namespace per-tenant so degscore normalizes to local baseline. also emit precision_decision events.

maya: per-call header? risky. only allow when policy.allow_per_call = true and audited.

ops-bot: sampling job queued for tenant_delta at 2026-04-05T06:00Z to measure flush penalty.

maya: action items: jordan draft schema (variant_list, safety_gates, cache_compat, quality_namespace, allow_per_call) by EOD; sam prototype decision logic in harness by next Tue; ops-bot post sampling results when ready.

sam: add nightly shadowing of fp8 to detect regressions before enabling tenant opt-ins.

maya: thanks, team :thumbsup:
